request.question: How must warranty claim WD-26-30417 be classified under WS-2024?

options.description: covered: The claim is within warranty.
expired_24_month_term: The claim is outside warranty because the 24-month period (with any §2 extension) has ended.
expired_30_month_cap: The 24-month period (with extension) is still running, but the claim falls after the §6 30-month manufacture limit.
